stages.freeze_gate: Select one best seed/checkpoint using the predeclared full-video primary metric on internal validation. Require that model to exceed full GOLA-B on complete validation videos with coherent mechanism evidence; no minimum number of seeds and no requirement that other seeds improve. stages.confirmation: After freezing the selected best model, complete Baseline/A/B/C/AB/AC/BC/ABC with equal-capacity/equal-search alternatives, memory/search budget curves, fair serial timing, FLOPs with coverage and SUTrack-B224 transfer under matched training resources. Additional seeds are optional diagnostics; retain all already-run results, but their performance is not an acceptance requirement.
stages.final_acceptance: One selected best model, with the same fixed checkpoint on both official datasets, exceeds the same local complete GOLA-B by at least2 percentage points on every one of the five native metrics. Report all full native metrics/attributes/sequences/curves and fixed-checkpoint5000paired sequence confidence intervals, mechanisms and actualcost. Intervals support claims of statistical improvement; multi-seed averages, at least3positive seeds, and no-negative-other-seed requirements are removed. Selection uses internal full-video validation; officialtests verify the locked model. All comprehensive reports and synchronization receipts complete.
